approaches.name: Reuse existing seams end to end (recommended)
approaches.summary: Build the redesign on what the repo already has: CSS-variable tokens in globals.css, shadcn chart/sidebar + recharts 3, the existing /api/stream proxy and llm-chat component, existing ImagePart/ObjectStore/LlmClient, and a multipart Next route handler that streams to a new FastAPI upload router.
how: Theme: retheme only :root/.dark oklch tokens + @theme inline in app/globals.css (Tailwind v4 CSS-first, no tailwind.config); force dark default via next-themes defaultTheme=dark; chart-1..5 + --status-* drive recharts through shadcn ChartContainer config so no per-page color duplicates.

Chat: extend components/common/llm-chat via props (context, systemPromptKey, actions); stream through existing app/api/stream/[...path] (SSE passthrough of upstream.body with no-transform, force-dynamic already correct); add new chat paths to lib/api/stream-paths.

Upload: new app/api/receipt-reviews/route.ts does `await request.formData()` then re-posts FormData to FastAPI POST /receipt-reviews (python-multipart already a dep; UploadFile list[UploadFile]); validate type/size in both layers (Zod client side, magic-byte + size cap in API); API stores bytes via ObjectStore.put (OCI Object Storage impl exists) and creates a work_item through the intake path.

Review: new stage/service builds LlmRequest with ImagePart(s) and calls LlmClient.parse with a Pydantic schema (structured outputs); Opus 5.5 (vision-capable, ZDR eligible) with explicit effort, check stop_reason==refusal; Haiku only for chat/summaries per CLAUDE.md.

Dashboard: new /reports-backed aggregate endpoints (matched count, applied money grouped by currency, per-model accuracy/cost from llm_usage, adjudicator agreement, auto-fix rate) rendered with KpiCard + recharts via ChartContainer.
evidence: web/package.json (next 16.3.8, react 19.2.8, recharts ^3.10.1, tailwindcss ^4, shadcn ^4.22.1, base-ui)
api/src/cashapp/integrations/llm/base.py:45 ImagePart (png/jpeg/gif/webp) and anthropic_client.py:59-65 image content blocks
https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/vision (limits: 5MB/image API, up to ~100 images, 8000px max edge; resize large)
risks: web/proxy.ts exists: Next buffers request bodies through proxy (default 10MB, experimental proxyClientMaxBodySize); multi-image uploads >10MB are silently truncated, so cap per-file (e.g. 5MB, Anthropic's per-image limit) and total, or exclude the upload path in the proxy matcher
Route handlers buffer formData() fully in memory; fine for few images, not for large PDFs

Opus thinking cannot be disabled and forced tool_choice 400s; review latency means the call must run async via worker/outbox, with the UI polling or SSE the item rather than blocking the upload request
Image-only failed receipts are not remittances: review result must be grounded; ungrounded values go to a person per CLAUDE.md
Version-specific Next 16 APIs (RouteContext typed globals, proxy.ts) differ from training data: read node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding

approaches.name: Direct browser-to-API upload with pre-authenticated Object Storage PAR
approaches.summary: Avoid pushing image bytes through Next at all: API issues an OCI Object Storage pre-authenticated request (PAR) for a per-upload object key; browser PUTs the file directly to OCI; then a small JSON call registers the artifacts and creates the work item.
how: POST /receipt-reviews/uploads (JSON) returns N PAR URLs with short expiry and fixed object keys (oci ObjectStorageClient.create_preauthenticated_request, AccessType ObjectWrite, Ashburn).
Browser PUTs each file directly with XHR for progress bars; then POST /receipt-reviews {object_keys} via the normal Next proxy (small JSON).
API verifies existence/size/magic bytes via ObjectStore.exists/get, builds ImageParts, runs review as before.
CORS on the bucket must allow the web origin PUT.
evidence: api/src/cashapp/integrations/storage/oci.py and base.py (ObjectStore lacks a PAR method, needs interface extension)
risks: Bypasses the API for bytes, so validation happens after the fact; unvalidated content lives in the bucket until checked
Needs bucket CORS and PAR infra (infra/ Terraform) and cannot be exercised with the local store, so the local/dev path diverges
Expands ObjectStore interface and OCI IAM; browser sees a bucket URL (customer remittance content must stay inside OCI, which it does, but PAR leakage risk)
Overkill for 'one or more receipt images' at a start

approaches.name: Server Action upload plus client polling instead of SSE for review status
approaches.summary: Use a Next Server Action (with serverActions.bodySizeLimit raised) to forward FormData to FastAPI and revalidate; show review status via periodic server-component refresh rather than a new SSE channel.
how: Server Action receives FormData, validates with Zod, forwards via lib/api/client to POST /receipt-reviews, returns Result-style value.
Raise experimental/serverActions bodySizeLimit (default 1MB) in next.config.ts to ~12mb.
Item page shows pipeline status via router.refresh() interval or existing flow SSE (live-indicator).
risks: Server Actions are POST-only, serialized per client, and give no upload progress; poor for multi-image UX
Repo convention is thin route-handler proxies typed from OpenAPI; a second mechanism breaks DRY
Body limit tuning is global to all actions
